# Application Reliability

The **application team view**: SLOs and error budget, user-journey health, request/failure/latency, exceptions, dependency reliability, and release correlation - sourced from Application Insights workspace-based tables.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

parameters.name: LogAnalyticsWorkspaceId
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project value = id, label = name, selected = false | order by label asc

content.json:
## Reliability at a glance

Headline SLIs for the selected window: request volume, failure rate, and tail latency against the SLO.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(Success == false)
| extend FailPct = iff(Total > 0, round(100.0*Failed/Total, 2), 0.0)
| extend Posture = case(Total == 0, 'ELEVATED', FailPct > 5, 'CRITICAL', FailPct > 1, 'DEGRADED', 'HEALTHY')
| project Posture, Requests = Total
content.title: SLO posture

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize ['Requests'] = count(), ['Failures'] = countif(Success == false),
            ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0),
            ['p99 ms'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 99), 0)
| project Metric = 'Requests', Value = ['Requests']
| union (AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Value = countif(Success == false) | extend Metric = 'Failures' | project Metric, Value)
| union (AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Value = toint(round(percentile(DurationMs,95),0)) | extend Metric = 'p95 ms' | project Metric, Value)
content.title: Reliability KPIs

## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "Application Reliability" and WorkbookPage == "Application Reliability"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

content.json:
## Application health & SLO

Headline reliability for the selected application: success rate, error budget remaining, and burn rate against your SLO target.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(Success == false)
| extend SuccessRatePct = round(100.0*(Total-Failed)/Total, 3),
         ErrorBudgetTarget = 99.9
| extend BudgetRemainingPct = round((SuccessRatePct - ErrorBudgetTarget) / (100 - ErrorBudgetTarget) * 100, 1)
content.title: Request success rate (SLI)

## Availability tests

Outside-in synthetic availability and pass rate by test. Catches user-facing outages telemetry alone can miss.

content.query:
AppAvailabilityResults
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Runs = count(), SuccessRate = round(100.0*countif(Success==true)/count(),2), AvgDurationMs = round(avg(DurationMs),0) by Name
| order by SuccessRate asc
content.title: Availability test results

content.json:
## Request volume & failure rate

Throughput and failure trend over time. Pre-aggregated by hour to stay within the chart point budget on wide time ranges.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests and failures over time

content.json:
## Latency (p50/p95/p99)

Latency percentiles over time. p95/p99 reveal tail pain that averages hide.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize p50 = percentile(DurationMs,50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs,95), p99 = percentile(DurationMs,99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Request duration percentiles

content.json:
## Exceptions

Top exception types driving failures. Feeds RCA and is a primary remediation target.

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by ExceptionType, ProblemId
| order by Count desc
| take 20
content.title: Top exceptions

content.json:
## Dependencies

Downstream dependency failure rate and latency. Many app incidents are really a dependency's incident.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Calls = count(), Failures = countif(Success==false), p95Ms = round(percentile(DurationMs,95),0) by Target, DependencyType
| extend FailureRatePct = round(100.0*Failures/Calls,2)
| order by Failures desc
| take 25
content.title: Dependency reliability

## User journeys

Health of the key multi-step user journeys (e.g. sign-in -> search -> checkout). Map journey steps to operation names.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), FailureRatePct = round(100.0*countif(Success==false)/count(),2), p95Ms = round(percentile(DurationMs,95),0) by OperationName
| order by Requests desc
| take 25
content.title: Top operations (journey steps)

## Release correlation & coverage gaps

Deployments/feature-flag changes lined up against reliability, plus telemetry and synthetic-test coverage gaps for this app.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationNameValue has_any ('publish','deploy','slotsswap','restart')
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, _ResourceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Deployment-time activity (App Service/Functions)

### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
